author: Sabrina Ramonov
basis: First-person business anecdote plus illustrative prompt
reported_outcomes: Reports avoiding a proposed marketing spend; the claim that it would have failed is counterfactual and unverified.
proposed_outcomes: Surface business risks and overlooked questions.
limits: Claims of becoming 10 times smarter or saving hours are unsupported.
Paid-plan requirements and product memory claims are dated, not prerequisites for the routine.
A sparring prompt can invent objections or flatter the user through apparent toughness.
review_note: Merge as a business variant of answering questions about one’s belief. Use supplied task facts, not indiscriminate personal or client disclosure.
coverage: Close-read all 178 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
